name: 30087 · Stone Mtn, GA
findings: ZIP 30087 (Stone Mtn) has 215 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30087 (Stone Mtn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30087 (Stone Mtn) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
